assumptions: Authorization is issue 2459, dispatched by the coordinating Claude session acting as dispatcher for PR #2991; repo-maintenance only, no migration lane and no db claim.
Only the stale-mutex recovery allowlist and its tests change; lock acquisition behaviour is untouched.
goal: Make every owner-commit kind that acquires the author mutex recoverable by stale-mutex recovery, with a structural test so a new lock kind cannot ship unrecoverable.
prohibited_actions: No database, migration, preview, production, claim or marker mutation.
No hand deletion of refs; no workflow, repository setting or branch protection change.
stop_conditions: Stop if recovery would need to accept a commit kind that does not acquire the author mutex.
Stop if the full lanes test suite regresses.
